third_party_evaluations.summary: Advanced web-app exploitation: SSTI, deserialization, NoSQLi, custom payload chains.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 3. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Advanced payload chains and fully practical testing with explicit senior rigor support expert web-exploitation depth; the four-year profile and absent Japanese recognition limit claims of wider enterprise leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded practical custom payload chains, deserialization and advanced injection provide expert web-exploitation depth. Senior-rigor factors and the expert hint support that judgment despite a four-year rather than six-year experience profile.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded fully practical advanced exploitation includes SSTI, deserialization, NoSQL injection and custom chains. Its senior-rigor factor supports expert web exploitation despite a typical profile below six years.
